description: Per-character NLS word-sort weights (CompareInfo.GetSortKey sections, hex) for U+0020-U+007E and U+00C0-U+00FF except U+00D7 and U+00F7, plus vectors: random type names and the order build.xsl's xsl:sort select=@type gave them on .NET Framework 4.8 (order lists indexes into types). Recorded by probe/sk.ps1 and probe/probe.ps1.
